observations.note: ICONIQ's survey of software companies building AI products: gross margin on their AI products in 2025. The report is undated, so it is dated at retrieval; its projections for 2026 and 2027 are not stored, because a projection is not a reading.
observations.raw_snippet: Gross margins are improving, jumping from 45% in 2025 to a projected 53% in 2026, and 59% in 2027.

source.attribution: ICONIQ, 'State of AI: The Builder's Economy' (2026), a survey of over 300 software executives building AI products
